notes: This bounded contract covers the implemented IEEE 1516.1-2025 Attribute Relevance Advisory path in Umbra's non-installable embedded development profile. The registry plans Turn Updates On/Off advisories when active ordinary or active overlapping regional subscriptions and update-region associations cause an owned attribute to enter or leave effective scope; passive declaration state remains retained but cannot arrange a relevance advisory. The adapter rechecks ownership, knowledge, scope, and the Attribute Relevance Advisory Switch before invoking the official callback. Explicit subscription designators are retained and select the rate-bearing Turn Updates On overload; omitted/default-rate subscriptions select the no-rate overload. Queued Turn Updates On callbacks resolve the currently retained designator again at callback entry, including regional overlap changes. The callback's complete update-rate enforcement/reduction semantics, Advisories Use Known Class behavior, initial registration/discovery-time advisory generation, complete regional DDM semantics, MOM, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
